entries.name: cls(col)
entries.description: Fill the character screen with col.

entries.name: put(cx, cy, str, col1?, col2?)
entries.description: Persistent cell text; foreground/background: omit/null = PCG.

entries.name: spr(x, y, str, col)
entries.description: 8px-spaced text; newlines, transparent background, one frame; max 128 characters per frame.

entries.name: btn(id)
entries.description: True while the button is held.

entries.name: btnp(id)
entries.description: True on a new press; same IDs as btn.

entries.name: play(ch, str)
entries.description: Play sound on channel 0–2 using ZX 128 PLAY.

entries.name: pcg[chr]
entries.description: 8-byte pattern and foreground/background colors; max 256 modified characters per run, 256 bytes written per frame.

entries.name: scr[cy][cx]
entries.description: Cell character and colors; null inherits PCG colors.

entries.name: tick()
entries.description: Update the game at 60 Hz.

entries.name: cdefgab
entries.description: Notes in the current octave.

entries.name: CDEFGAB
entries.description: Notes one octave higher.

entries.name: O0–O8
entries.description: Set octave; O5c is middle C.
Sharp, flat and rest.

sound.title: Lengths

entries.description: Triplets apply to the next three notes.
Tie by adding note lengths together.

sound.description: Write the length before notes: 5ceg = quarter notes. Default: 5.

entries.name: T60–T240
entries.description: Tempo in BPM; set on channel 0.

entries.name: V0–V15
entries.description: Set volume, from silent to loud.

entries.name: U · X0–X65535
entries.description: U: envelope unless V is used. X: period (X0 = X1/2).

entries.name: W0–W7
entries.description: Select a volume envelope shape.

entries.name: M1–M63
entries.description: Tone bits 1/2/4; noise bits 8/16/32.
Repeat twice / loop forever.

entries.name: H
entries.description: Stop all channels at this point.

entries.name: N
entries.description: Separate adjacent numbers.
Ignore text between ! marks.
